entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell cast by Freyalise in 2934 AR to break the Shard and end the Ice Age, starting the Thaw.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Tried to stop the spell's effect and cover the world with ice again.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Used by Lim-Dûl to study a rogue plane; his mirror was used in the casting, and he dispersed the energy.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Used Jodah to study a rogue plane.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Moon-marked girl present at the casting; later Elder Druid of the Juniper Order.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: In the comic version, gave Freyalise the idea to combine forces.

entities.name: Ice Cauldron
entities.description: Replica of the Golgothian Sylex built by Freyalise for the spell.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact replicated by the Ice Cauldron.

entities.name: Jodah's mirror
entities.description: Mirror that shows the land its true self; altered by the spell.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era on Dominaria ended by the World Spell.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: New age started by the World Spell.

entities.name: Juniper Order
entities.description: Order whose Elder Druid Kaysa became.

events.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell in 2934 AR to break the Shard and end the Ice Age, beginning the Thaw.
events.quote: The World Spell was cast by the planeswalker Freyalise in 2934 AR to break the Shard and end the Ice Age on Dominaria .

events.summary: Freyalise learns Lim-Dûl used Jodah to study a rogue plane and finds the plane's energy can end the Shard.
events.quote: she could use the energy waves caused by the plane's arrival to end The Shard and the Ice Age

events.summary: Freyalise places Jodah's mirror into the Ice Cauldron; Jodah disperses the energy over Terisiare, destroying the safe havens.
events.quote: would have caused equal devastation if Jodah had not dispersed it over the continent of Terisiare via the safe havens

events.summary: Heidar tries to stop the spell's effect and re-cover the world in ice.
events.quote: Heidar tried to stop the effect of that spell and to cover the entire world with ice again.

events.summary: In the comic version, Kristina of the Woods gives Freyalise the idea to combine forces at the Summit of the Null Moon, using Kaysa's powers.
events.quote: Kristina of the Woods gave Freyalise the idea to combine forces to end the Shard and the Ice Age during the Summit of the Null Moon .

relations.note: built as a Golgothian Sylex replica
relations.quote: the Ice Cauldron , which Freyalise had built as a replica of the Golgothian Sylex

relations.quote: Jodah had been used by Lim-Dûl to study a rogue plane
